question: The 'NavIC' is an independent regional navigation satellite system being developed by which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• NAVIC is an independent Indian Satellite based positioning system.
 
• It is an acronym for NAVigation with Indian Constellation.
 
• It is the operational name of the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS).
 
• It covers India and a region extending 1,500 km around it, with plans for further extension.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The system is intended to provide an absolute position accuracy of better than 10 meters (33 ft) throughout the Indian landmass and better than 20 meters (66 ft) in the region extending approximately 1,500 km (930 mi) around India.
 
• The system currently consists of a constellation of seven satellites, with two additional satellites on the ground as stand-by.
 
• NAVIC will provide two levels of service, the "standard positioning service", which will be open for civilian use, and a "restricted service" (an encrypted one) for authorized users (including the military).
